verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://posthog.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. First-party docs also say each PostHog Endpoint publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec at /api/projects/{project_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_name}/openapi.json, with request and response schemas and auth requirements, for typed SDK generation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the site-level openapi.json (its coverage of the full REST API and versioning), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using it for client generation.
